rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a sovereign state or country.

example.english: This nation has its own currency.
example.traditional: 呢個國家有自己嘅貨幣。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 fo3 bai6

rows.note: Use this for a historically or culturally constituted people group, especially an ethnic nation rather than a state.

example.english: This nation has preserved its own language.
example.traditional: 呢個民族保留咗自己嘅語言。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 man4 zuk6 bou2 lau4 zo2 zi6 gei2 ge3 jyu5 jin4

rows.note: Use this when the nation is viewed as its citizens or nationals, rather than as an ethnic-cultural group; it does not mean the state itself.

example.english: Citizens of the nation have the right to take part in elections.
example.jyutping: gwok3 man4 jau5 kyun4 caam1 jyu6 syun2 geoi2

rows.note: Use this for the people or populace collectively when referring to a nation, not for the nation as a sovereign state.

example.english: The people of the nation are demanding an explanation from the government.
example.jyutping: jan4 man4 jiu1 kau4 zing3 fu2 gaau1 doi6
